item.title: The Point – 16 Point Road, Bellport Village, New York, NY, USA 🇺🇸 – $12,500,000
item.description: Set on 3.37 private waterfront acres, “The Point” is a rare Bellport Village legacy estate blending classic 1920s architecture with modern coastal living. Featuring sweeping Great South Bay views, a private beach, deep-water dock, tennis court, and resort-style pool, this irreplaceable property offers enduring elegance just moments from the charm of Bellport Village.
